title: Fee Schedule Insert — Lateness, Returned Payments and Courtesy on Belrose Promotional Financing Plans
content:
# Fee Schedule Insert — Lateness, Returned Payments and Courtesy on Belrose Promotional Financing Plans

This insert accompanies the statement for a Belrose Promotional Financing Plan and states the fees for a late payment and for a payment the bank returns unpaid, together with the grace the plan allows and the courtesy the desk may extend. Every figure depends on the promotional term the plan was written on.

## Late payments

| Term | 6-Month Deferred Interest | 12-Month Deferred Interest | 18-Month Deferred Interest | 24-Month Equal Payment | 36-Month Equal Payment | 48-Month Bridal Equal Payment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Grace after the payment due date, calendar days | 3 | 3 | 5 | 5 | 7 | 7 |
| Fee for the first lateness within the repeat window | 29.00 USD | 29.00 USD | 32.00 USD | 35.00 USD | 38.00 USD | 41.00 USD |
| Fee for a later lateness within the repeat window | 39.00 USD | 39.00 USD | 41.00 USD | 41.00 USD | 41.00 USD | 41.00 USD |
| Repeat window, rolling whole months | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 |
| Ceiling on any single late fee, share of the scheduled monthly payment | 100 percent | 100 percent | 100 percent | 100 percent | 100 percent | 100 percent |

## Returned payments

| Term | 6-Month Deferred Interest | 12-Month Deferred Interest | 18-Month Deferred Interest | 24-Month Equal Payment | 36-Month Equal Payment | 48-Month Bridal Equal Payment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Fee for a payment the bank returns unpaid | 29.00 USD | 29.00 USD | 29.00 USD | 32.00 USD | 32.00 USD | 35.00 USD |
| Largest number of returned-payment fees within one billing cycle | 1 | 1 | 1 | 2 | 2 | 2 |

## Courtesy

| Term | 6-Month Deferred Interest | 12-Month Deferred Interest | 18-Month Deferred Interest | 24-Month Equal Payment | 36-Month Equal Payment | 48-Month Bridal Equal Payment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Late fees that may be given back as a courtesy in a rolling twelve months | 1 | 1 | 1 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| Whole months the plan must have been billing before a courtesy give-back may be granted | 3 | 3 | 6 | 6 | 9 | 12 |

## In plain terms

- **Grace** is counted in calendar days after the payment due date: 3 days on the 6-Month Deferred Interest Plan and the 12-Month Deferred Interest Plan, 5 days on the 18-Month Deferred Interest Plan and the 24-Month Equal Payment Plan, and 7 days on the 36-Month Equal Payment Plan and the 48-Month Bridal Equal Payment Plan.
- **The first-lateness fee** rises with the term from 29.00 USD to 41.00 USD; **the repeat fee** stands at 39.00 USD on the two shortest terms and 41.00 USD on every other term, so that on the 48-Month Bridal Equal Payment Plan the first-lateness fee and the repeat fee are the same figure.
- **The repeat window** is 6 rolling whole months on every term, and no single late fee exceeds 100 percent of the scheduled monthly payment on any term.
- **The returned-payment fee** stands at 29.00 USD on the three deferred interest terms, 32.00 USD on the 24-Month Equal Payment Plan and the 36-Month Equal Payment Plan, and 35.00 USD on the 48-Month Bridal Equal Payment Plan; no more than 1 such fee is charged within one billing cycle on the deferred interest terms and no more than 2 on the equal payment terms.
- **Courtesy** allows 1 late fee to be given back in a rolling twelve months on the deferred interest terms and 2 on the equal payment terms, once the plan has been billing for the stated number of whole months: 3 months on the two shortest terms, 6 months on the 18-Month Deferred Interest Plan and the 24-Month Equal Payment Plan, 9 months on the 36-Month Equal Payment Plan and 12 months on the 48-Month Bridal Equal Payment Plan.
